svg.title: The Moon above Jaipur
svg.desc: Earth-facing lunar seas, highlands, craters and bright rays, from NASA Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter imagery. Gently warmed to ivory for the illustrated night sky.
svg.metadata: Source: https://science.nasa.gov/resource/lunar-near-side/ — NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center/Arizona State University. Cropped and resized; light tonal treatment for the Bansal illustration. Decorative full Moon, not a live lunar-phase display.
